figurative_meaning_en: To be overwhelmed or helpless in the face of minor difficulties
similar_in_english: Making a mountain out of a molehill
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে হাঁটুজলে ডুবে মরা, এত ছোট একটা সমস্যায় এত চিন্তা করে।
জীবনে সামান্য বাধায় হাঁটুজলে ডুবে মরবেন না, সাহস দেখান।
example_sentences_in_english: He's drowning in knee-deep water, worrying so much over such a small problem.
Don't die in shallow water in life; face minor obstacles with courage.
note: This idiom vividly illustrates Bengali cultural tendency to use water-related metaphors for vulnerability in everyday hardships.
